metadata.title: Super Massive Black Holes and the Origin of High-Velocity Stars

notes: No identifiable individual star is named or analyzed by this paper. The HVS references at T:p1-b9 ("a B-type star" and "21 HVSs") are background population examples without catalog identifiers or object-specific analysis. The analysis at T:p2-b6 and T:p3-b6 concerns generic simulated 1 M_sun test stars and aggregate populations of escaping stars, not individually identified stars. Therefore no star qualifies under either contribution category.
